af19412ab40ede0f03c0c2d59ec66451053294ec.sourceText: 上实物前应先核对原点离地高度、`odom` 竖直方向和位姿转换。窗口过窄会丢坡面，过宽会引入顶棚或其他楼层；是否成为障碍还取决于局部地面估计及后续筛选。当前不据这些数值直接修改重力方向或安装外参。
af19412ab40ede0f03c0c2d59ec66451053294ec.translatedText: Before installing the physical object, first verify the origin height above the ground,`odom` vertical direction, and pose transformation\. A window that is too narrow will lose the slope surface, while one that is too wide will introduce the ceiling or other floors; whether it becomes an obstacle also depends on local ground estimation and subsequent filtering\. Currently, the gravity direction or installation extrinsics are not directly modified based on these values\.

af3ef120a85aa8085717f910d3c2fa00463b9a7d.sourceText: 后面的章节会从 C++ 基础语法开始讲：
af3ef120a85aa8085717f910d3c2fa00463b9a7d.translatedText: Subsequent chapters will start with the C++ basic syntax:

af450fb920ac2e946242297df700a9510b123b6e.sourceText: 这个文件里面需要修改的是：
af450fb920ac2e946242297df700a9510b123b6e.translatedText: In this file, what needs to be modified is:

afd0dd5459d22b467077cb1deaea09354b62baa9.sourceText:
| 启动方式 | 参数与地图来源 | 当前区别 |
|---|---|---|
| 整套reality导航，slam=False | 实物nav2_params.yaml，经localization_launch传入；PCD由launch参数字典另传 | 本表值；默认world对应的实物地图文件缺失，需准备当前场地地图 |
| 整套simulation导航，slam=False | 仿真nav2_params.yaml，同样另传PCD | 除use_sim_time=True外，本块12项相同；默认仿真地图存在 |
| 整套slam=True | 进入slam_launch，不进入localization_launch | 本节点不运行，不能用建图输出说明本块已验证 |
| 包内独立launch | 自己写的参数字典，不读取整套YAML | num_neighbors=10，两种leaf_size均0.25，max_dist_sq=1.0，输入cloud_registered，frame与PCD默认空；不能直接当整套入口 |
afd0dd5459d22b467077cb1deaea09354b62baa9.translatedText:
| Startup method | Parameter and map sources | Current differences |
|---|---|---|
| Full reality navigation set, slam=False | Physical nav2_params.yaml, passed in via localization_launch; PCD is passed separately via the launch parameter dictionary | Values in this table; the physical map file corresponding to the default world is missing, and a map of the current site needs to be prepared |
| Full simulation navigation set, slam=False | Simulated nav2_params.yaml, likewise with PCD passed separately | Except for use_sim_time=True, the 12 items in this block are the same; the default simulation map exists |
| Full set slam=True | Enters slam_launch, does not enter localization_launch | This node does not run; the mapping output cannot be used to show that this block has been verified |
| Independent launch within the package | Self\-written parameter dictionary, does not read the full YAML set | num_neighbors=10, both types of leaf_size are 0\.25, max_dist_sq=1\.0, input cloud_registered, frame and PCD default to empty; cannot be used directly as the full entry point |

afd52a1750e2d61f8f688b348a04508c09449753.sourceText: 不同区域存放的数据，赋予不同的生命周期, 给我们更大的灵活编程
afd52a1750e2d61f8f688b348a04508c09449753.translatedText: Data stored in different regions is given different lifecycles, providing us with greater programming flexibility\.

aff45f8e49ef0346840dc6cc51cd108a97937381.sourceText: `plane_thr` 检查地图邻点自己是否平整；`match_s` 检查新点能否对上这个面。两项不能只因为地图不好看就一起放宽，时间和外参错误也会造成类似现象。
aff45f8e49ef0346840dc6cc51cd108a97937381.translatedText: `plane_thr` Check whether the neighboring map point itself is flat;`match_s` Check whether the new point can align with this plane\. The two criteria cannot both be relaxed simply because the map looks bad; timing and extrinsic calibration errors can also produce similar phenomena\.
